correctness.rationale: The triangle inequality through the antipode of the first point gives P≤2π. Away from coincident/antipodal first pairs, equality requires the third point on the opposite great-circle arc, with endpoints given by the antipodes of the first two. On a compact interior of this arc the latitude deficit has the stated positive quadratic coefficient. Globally the Gram bound controls the conditional latitude area by min(1,sqrt(2ε)/sin κ); multiplication by sin κ makes first-pair endpoint strips contribute O(strip width × sqrt(ε)). On compact κ intervals the same bound controls longitude endpoint strips, and continuity excludes longitudes away from the closed equality arc. This justifies the √ε limit for bounded continuous likelihoods, with independent Haar orientation. Integrating latitude gives sqrt(2)I/(4π); pinning one circular phase, sorting the other two and using the Dyson integral gives I=(π²/2^(5/2))Γ(7/4)/Γ(5/4)^3. The dipole pair mean is ||d||² c/3, its odd terms vanish under the coplanar half-turn, and the symmetric cosine sum is strictly positive. Circular integration by parts gives E|Σ exp(iθ)|²=2 at β=1/2, with integrable collision derivatives; hence E cos²x=5/12 and E cos x cos y cos w=-1/8 by the triangle-angle identity. This verifies the pair contribution tr(A²)/20. Independently the uniform sixth moment of squared projections is (1+2Σ c_ij²+8 c_12 c_23 c_31)/105 by pairing; expanding three P2 terms gives the stated kernel and mean -1/56. The sole cubic trace-zero symmetric invariant is tr(A³), giving coefficient -1/42 after testing the axisymmetric matrix. If q=tr(A²)>0, then I+A positive with trace 3 implies q<6; the sharp fixed-q trace bound gives tr(A³)<q. Along t diag(2,-1,-1), the cubic-to-quadratic ratio is t, proving strict enhancement and the optimal 11/420 limit as t rises to one. Replay: RESULT.md lines 34–103 and the foregoing checks. Independent product Gauss–Legendre quadrature after κ=π sin²(πv/2), x=κ sin²(πu/2), gave m≈0.429699113626273 and C*≈0.242332519572411; these are diagnostics only. The uploaded verify.py was inspected, not executed.
